details.text: We foam every carpenter bee hole with an expanding insecticide foam that seals the tunnel, then treat all the exposed wood on the outside of your home to prevent new holes.
We treat every active nest and remove it from your home, then do a full outside treatment that prevents new nests all year.

Your first 3 treatments come over the first 3 months. The first two are 2 weeks apart to knock out what you're seeing, and the third usually comes right before the monthly fee starts in month 4. Signature covers 30+ pests inside and out, with free return visits if they come back between treatments.

details.text: We seal the entry points around the outside foundation of your home where pests and rodents get in, using expanding foam, copper mesh and steel hardware cloth. This isn't construction work: we don't repair foundations or replace siding, shingles or roofing.

We identify the animal from the signs it left, set traps and stations around your home, and come out every day for 7 days to check them, remove the animals from the property and reset the traps and bait. A two-week follow-up visit checks that the activity has stopped and covers prevention around your home.

We identify which animal is digging, then come out every day for 7 days to treat the active burrows with stations and traps and remove the animals from the property. A two-week follow-up visit focuses on prevention and checking that the activity has stopped.
We also apply a granular repellent around your home and yard to help keep them away, and you have 3 months of coverage: free return visits if they come back.

lines.text: Termite activity treated directly with foam and a soil treatment
Liquid soil treatment around the home

text.text: the soil treatment and bait stations, with a damage warranty

details.text: We treat the soil directly where wood touches the ground with our liquid termite treatment, to protect those spots and eliminate the colony.
We treat the signs of termites directly, with a foam application into the affected wood and a liquid treatment in the soil, to eliminate the colony.
We then install our termite bait station system around the outside of your home, about every 15 to 20 feet, to protect the whole house and back your warranty.

finePrint: The damage warranty covers new termite damage while your plan is active. It doesn't cover damage that's already there.
